name: agent-survey
description: Let your agent answer paid research campaigns under your policy (rewards in SOL), or run campaigns and buy reports over x402 (USDC) on Solana devnet.

web_url.title: Platform web URL
web_url.description: Agent Survey web app, used for sign-in and funding links

agent_token.title: Respondent agent token
agent_token.description: Create it at <web_url>/seller/agent after connecting your Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack). Leave empty for research-only use.

agent_solana_secret_key.title: Agent wallet secret key (Solana devnet)
agent_solana_secret_key.description: Small devnet keypair (base58 secret key or the JSON byte array from solana-keygen) that pays the 3 USDC report fee over x402 and, within max_budget_sol, funds the agent's own campaigns. Never your main wallet.

solana_rpc_url.title: Solana RPC URL
solana_rpc_url.description: Devnet RPC used to build the x402 USDC payment

max_report_price_usdc.title: Max USDC per report
max_report_price_usdc.description: Hard cap the agent may pay for one report over x402 (the platform fee is 3 USDC)

max_budget_sol.title: Max SOL per campaign the agent may fund
max_budget_sol.description: fund_campaign refuses budgets above this; 0 = always hand funding to a human
